analysis.title: USA: Empire Manufacturing Below Expectations
key_insights: The Empire manufacturing index fell 17.7pt to 7.8 in November, against a median forecast of 18.0 and a prior reading of 25.5. It unwound most of October's increase, which had put the index at its highest level since December 2021.
GS reads the reversal as consistent with business surveys pointing to a healthy pace of economic activity but no sign of a surge to a far above-trend pace.
The composition was mixed-to-weak. New orders fell 20.2pt to 3.0 and shipments fell 4.3pt to 8.8, reversing most of last month's gains.
The employment component rose 7.8pt to 18.1, its highest level since February 2022.
The 6-months-ahead business conditions index rose 7.9pt to 28.9.

Price components fell across the board. Current prices paid fell 13.6pt to 45.9 and expected prices paid fell 4.2pt to 66.7. Current prices received fell 3.4pt to 27.2 and expected prices received fell 6.8pt to 41.2.
